ideas.title: Choose a collecting goal before buying
ideas.premise: Help collectors define a focused goal so purchases serve a collection instead of short-term hype.

ideas.title: Match the Pokemon TCG product format to the collector
ideas.premise: Explain how common sealed product formats serve different goals without presenting one as universally best.
ideas.notes: Verify current product terminology before planning.

ideas.title: A simple card protection and storage ladder
ideas.premise: Show an escalating protection workflow for ordinary pulls, binder cards, and higher-value cards.

ideas.title: Raw versus graded: start with purpose
ideas.premise: Frame the raw-or-graded decision around display, protection, liquidity, and personal preference rather than guaranteed value.

ideas.title: Why sold listings matter more than asking prices
ideas.premise: Teach collectors to separate completed market activity from optimistic listings.
ideas.notes: Use illustrative language unless current marketplace data is sourced.

ideas.title: Condition changes every price comparison
ideas.premise: Explain why surface, corners, edges, centering, and provenance must be considered before comparing sales.

ideas.title: How reprints can change the supply picture
ideas.premise: Explain the relationship between new supply, availability, and market expectations without predicting prices.
ideas.notes: Any named reprint requires current official sourcing.

ideas.title: Set a collecting budget that survives hype
ideas.premise: Give collectors a repeatable way to separate planned collecting money from impulse spending.
ideas.notes: Keep this educational and avoid individualized financial advice.

ideas.title: Build a calm drop-day checklist
ideas.premise: Prepare accounts, payment details, notifications, and spending limits before a release without promising stock.

ideas.title: How to verify a restock rumor
ideas.premise: Teach a source-checking sequence that distinguishes official confirmation, credible observation, and speculation.

ideas.title: Read retailer rules before release day
ideas.premise: Show why purchase limits, account requirements, queues, pickup rules, and regional terms should be checked at the source.
ideas.notes: Do not quote retailer rules without researching their current official pages.

ideas.title: Spot suspicious drop links before clicking
ideas.premise: Offer a practical URL, account, payment, and urgency check for collectors encountering release links.
ideas.notes: Research current consumer-protection guidance before drafting claims.

ideas.title: What kind of collector are you right now?
ideas.premise: Invite collectors to identify with binder building, set completion, sealed collecting, gameplay, or art-focused collecting.

ideas.title: Build a binder page that tells a story
ideas.premise: Give collectors prompts for arranging a nine-card page around art, character, era, color, or memory.

ideas.title: The story behind a favorite card
ideas.premise: Prompt the community to value the memory, person, pull, trade, or event attached to a card rather than price alone.

ideas.title: Create a one-month collecting challenge
ideas.premise: Invite the audience to choose one bounded collecting goal and share progress without making purchases mandatory.
